lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 107410112 · After Nom Nom Nom chat 2. Bonne Bouche.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Bonne Bouche!

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Where did you go?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: We've come up with a great solution.
Bready has invited Crust to join the group.
Bready has invited Ade to join the group.
Bready has invited Tia to join the group.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: We can talk here, everyone.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Hey, Mr. Gourmand! Fancy seeing you here.

lines.speaker: ade_c
lines.text: Hi, Master :)

lines.speaker: tia_c
lines.text: Hello, Teacher!
Did you all have something to tell me?

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: We've all been thinking:

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: What if you try to cook an entire meal

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: from start to finish?
Huh?

lines.speaker: ade_c
lines.text: I heard that any food which you touch

lines.speaker: ade_c
lines.text: ends up tasting rather unique.

lines.speaker: tia_c
lines.text: That got us thinking.

lines.speaker: tia_c
lines.text: If your hands are indeed enchanted,

lines.speaker: tia_c
lines.text: what if you cooked an entire meal with those magic hands of yours?

lines.speaker: tia_c
lines.text: Surely that would be a big help for Miss Crust.
Why are you two getting involved in this all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: tia_c
lines.text: Isn't it obvious?

lines.speaker: tia_c
lines.text: Because it sounds like fun, haha!

lines.speaker: ade_c
lines.text: And while I might not be able to personally taste what you make,

lines.speaker: ade_c
lines.text: I'm still curious about this so-called "unique flavor" of yours.

lines.speaker: ade_c
lines.text: Watching Crust's research up close

lines.speaker: ade_c
lines.text: could also help us come up with ways

lines.speaker: ade_c
lines.text: to improve the menu at the cafe.
... Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: So where are you right now?

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: We prepared all the ingredients and the recipe.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: All we need is for you to come over!

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I'm so excited, hehe!

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Come on over to the kitchen.
Oh, sorry, but I'm a little busy right now.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Oh no, you are?

lines.speaker: tia_c
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: ade_c
lines.text: Darn, you're busy?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: We already prepared everything. What should we do?
I'll be right over. We'll have to make this quick.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Whoohoo! Of course!

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Be careful on your way here. We'll be waiting!
